decision.INVERTED: the intact - shuffled interval lies strictly below zero; reported as what it is, never read as a preference for disorder
decision.MOVES_WITH_EDITEDNESS: intact - shuffled lies above zero and sham - shuffled does not: the reader moves for surface damage as much as for order
decision.MOVES_WITH_ORDER: the intact - shuffled interval and the sham - shuffled interval both lie strictly above zero
decision.NULL: the intact - shuffled interval contains zero: the stop point does not move under the shuffle at this n; the direction closes for this reader
decision.UNREADABLE: fp5 not PASS, or a version under the scorable floor, or fewer than two feeds with a complete scorable triple

not_run.D1P: the platform-prior families need a seated reader and $16 of generation before any dose exists; the shuffle is the owned manipulation
not_run.fp6: the skim-price control is not run; no skim-derived number is read

registration.primary: target_read_share, paired per (feed, rotation): intact - shuffled
registration.secondary: abandonment_step, first full read on the target, paired the same way
registration.sham_reading: sham - shuffled, per sham and never pooled
